data.name: Hrithik
data.gender_notes: Hrithik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hrithik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hrithik', which means 'intelligent' and 'radiant'. This name is often given to babies born under the influence of the Sun or Lord Vishnu. It is believed that children with this name possess great wisdom, intelligence, and courage. The name Hrithik carries the meaning “Intelligent, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Hrithik usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hrithik is a sacred name, believed to be a blessing from Lord Vishnu. It is said that this name bestows intelligence, courage, and a strong connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Hrithik belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hrithik total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hṛd' meaning heart and 'tva' meaning you or all beings. The name signifies a person who has a heart full of compassion for all beings.

historical_references.reference: Hrithik Roshan is believed to be named after the ancient Hindu ruler Hrishikesh, who was a king of the Haihayas and is considered one of the 18 Maharajadhirajas of India. He is believed to have ruled between 1305 and 1325 AD.

Another theory suggests that Hrithik Roshan's name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Hrishikesa', which means 'the lord of senses'. This name appears in Hindu scriptures and is also an epithet of the god Vishnu.
